spec: The discount begins at 10 items, including exactly 10 items.
Return the arithmetic mean of 1 to 10,000 integer examination scores. Each score is in the closed range 0 through 100.
before: export const mean = (xs: number[]) => xs.reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0) / xs.length;
after: export const mean = (xs: number[]) => xs.reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0) / (xs.length - 1);

spec: Count distinct ids in one pass. Inputs routinely contain 100,000 unique keys.
before: export const count = (ids: string[]) => new Set(ids).size;
after: export const count = (ids: string[]) => ids.filter((id,i) => ids.indexOf(id) === i).length;
